LanguageData.BWT_Enum_SubWorkDrilldownModifier_Ctrl_D: Hold Ctrl with the configured mouse button to enter or leave the specific-job view.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_SubWorkDrilldownModifier_Shift_: Use Shift plus the configured mouse button for specific jobs. This may conflict with skill displays and column grouping.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_SubWorkDrilldownButton_Left_Des: Use the left mouse button with the configured modifier to enter or leave the specific-job view.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_SubWorkDrilldownButton_Right_De: Use the right mouse button with the configured modifier to enter or leave the specific-job view.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_SubWorkDrilldownStyle_NotChosen: No specific-job presentation has been selected yet. Better Work Tab will ask for a choice before opening that view.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_SubWorkDrilldownStyle_FocusView: Opens the chosen work type in a focused full-tab view containing only its specific jobs.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_SubWorkDrilldownStyle_ExpandBes: Expands the chosen work type's specific-job columns beside the parent column in the main Work table.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_SubWorkTransitionStyle_ClassicG: Slides specific-job columns into position and uses a brief flash during the transition.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_SubWorkTransitionStyle_PixelWav: Keeps columns in position while a grey pixel wave progressively reveals or hides the specific-job view.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_SubWorkDisabledParentMode_Paren: Vanilla behavior: disabling a Work type also disables its specific jobs, including locked priorities.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_SubWorkDisabledParentMode_Locke: In singleplayer, locked specific jobs can run while their parent is disabled. Multiplayer keeps vanilla parent-disable behavior for determinism.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_PriorityMode_Vanilla_Descriptio: Uses RimWorld's standard priority range and behavior. Better Work Tab does not own or expand the priority range.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_PriorityMode_Auto_Description: Uses vanilla priorities by default, then safely adopts a compatible expanded range when another provider or existing high priorities require it.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_PriorityMode_ExternalProvider_D: Delegates the priority range to the selected compatible external provider. Better Work Tab presents and edits the values supplied by that provider.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_PriorityMode_BetterWorkTab_Desc: Makes Better Work Tab own the expanded priority range and apply its configured maximum and priority-number colors.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_AutoDisabledPriorityMode_EveryM: When disabled work is re-enabled in Auto priority mode, assign the next priority aligned to a four-step band.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_AutoDisabledPriorityMode_FixedP: When disabled work is re-enabled in Auto priority mode, assign the exact fixed priority configured below this setting.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_ShowUIMode_Always_Description: Always displays this visual indicator, whether or not Shift is held.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_ShowUIMode_Shifted_Description: Displays this visual indicator only while Shift is held.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_ShowUIMode_Unshifted_Descriptio: Displays this visual indicator normally, then hides it while Shift is held.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_SkillViewHoverMode_Standard_Des: Keeps priority as the main cell value and shows skill information as the smaller secondary value, matching the priority-focused Work-tab interaction.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_SkillViewHoverMode_SkillFocused: Makes the skill level the large central value and moves priority to the smaller corner value while the hover effect is active.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_SkillViewHoverMode_None_Descrip: Does not change cell contents on hover. The normal priority and configured skill overlays remain as they were.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_HoverEffectScope_CellOnly_Descr: Applies the configured priority/skill hover presentation only to the single work cell under the pointer.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_HoverEffectScope_ColumnWide_Des: Applies the configured priority/skill hover presentation to every visible pawn cell in the work column under the pointer.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_WorkGridRendererMode_Auto_Descr: Uses the optimized renderer when compatible; otherwise, the Work grid falls back to vanilla. Other Better Work Tab features remain active.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_WorkGridRendererMode_Optimized_: Uses the optimized layered renderer. If a safety check fails, the Work grid falls back to vanilla.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_WorkGridRendererMode_Vanilla_De: Always uses RimWorld's native Work-grid renderer. Better Work Tab's other enabled features remain available around that vanilla rendering path.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_RulesetViewMode_Raw_Description: Shows the classic ruleset list for direct editing without the visual builder.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_RulesetViewMode_Regular_Descrip: Shows the guided visual rule builder as the ruleset editor.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_RulesetViewMode_Both_Descriptio: Makes both the visual rule builder and classic ruleset list available so the player can choose either workflow.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_WorkTabOwnerPreference_BetterWo: Keeps Better Work Tab in control of the Work tab and its compatibility infrastructure.
LanguageData.BWT_Enum_WorkTabOwnerPreference_FluffyWo: Hands the Work tab to Fluffy's Work Tab while Better Work Tab contains its own conflicting presentation features.
LanguageData.BWT_UseFluffyWorkTab_Confirm: Switching hands the Work tab to Fluffy's Work Tab. You can switch back any time in Better Work Tab's mod settings.
LanguageData.BWT_UseFluffyWorkTab_Tooltip: Run Fluffy's Work Tab instead of Better Work Tab.
LanguageData.BWT_FluffyActive_SettingsBanner: Fluffy's Work Tab is currently running the Work tab.
LanguageData.BWT_SwitchBackToBetterWorkTab_Button: Switch back to Better Work Tab
LanguageData.BWT_SwitchBackToBetterWorkTab_Tooltip: Run Better Work Tab as the Work tab again.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_compat.fluffyWorkTab.header: BWT-native options inspired by Fluffy's Work Tab, plus compatibility controls when Fluffy Work Tab or a fork is installed.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_fluffyStyle.features_Toolti: Enables BWT's Fluffy-inspired controls and right-expanding specific jobs. Fluffy Work Tab is not required.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_fluffyStyle.topButtons_Tool: With Fluffy installed, show its icons for manual priorities, schedules, and specific jobs.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_fluffyStyle.standaloneTopBu: Without Fluffy installed, show text versions of its three top controls. Disabled by default because its icons are unavailable.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_compat.fluffyWorkTab.owners: Choose which mod runs the Work tab and which Fluffy columns Better Work Tab keeps visible.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_compat.fluffyWorkTab.owner_: Choose whether Better Work Tab or Fluffy Work Tab runs the Work tab.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_compat.externalWorkTab.colu: While Better Work Tab owns the tab, keep Fluffy's Mood, Job, Detailed Copy/Paste, and Favorite columns visible.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_compat.fluffyWorkTab.specif: Choose how BWT opens a Work column into its individual jobs.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_subWorkJobs.drilldownStyle_: Choose a focused full-tab view or right-expanding columns. Both are BWT features and work without Fluffy installed.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_subWorkJobs.focusedHeaderBa: Keep specific-jobs button in Focus view
Shows a two-line “Back to Work types” button beneath the specific-job header in Focus view.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.masterToggle_Too: Master switch for all row and column highlighting. Turn off for a cleaner look or better performance.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.hoverHighlight_T: Tint the row and column under your cursor.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.hoverColor_Toolt: Color for row/column highlight on hover.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.selectedPawn_Too: Always highlight the currently selected pawn's row.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.floatMenu_Toolti: Highlight row/column when right-click menu is open.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.outlineMode_Tool: Draw highlights as outlines instead of solid boxes.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_layout.ctrlDrag_Tooltip: Hold Ctrl to drag rows/columns. Prevents accidental reordering.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_layout.clickClose: Keep Work tab open after selecting a pawn
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_layout.clickClose_Tooltip: Selecting a pawn keeps the Work tab open. While enabled, clicks outside the tab also leave it open.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_layout.pawnCount_Tooltip: Display colonist count in the bottom-left corner.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_layout.dividerHeight_Toolti: Default height of divider rows in pixels.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_layout.resetColumns_Tooltip: Restore all work columns to their default order.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_overlay.enable_Tooltip: Show skill information when holding Shift in the Work tab.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_overlay.numbersMode_Tooltip: When to show small skill numbers in cells.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_overlay.bestPawnMode_Toolti: When to highlight the pawn with highest skill.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_overlay.hoverCellOverlay_To: When enabled, hovering can emphasize either skill or priority in one cell or the whole column, according to the options below.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_colors.skillVeryLow_Tooltip: Text color for skill numbers shown while holding Shift. This does not change cell backgrounds.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_colors.skillLow_Tooltip: Text color for skill numbers shown while holding Shift. This does not change cell backgrounds.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_colors.skillGood_Tooltip: Text color for skill numbers shown while holding Shift. This does not change cell backgrounds.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_colors.skillExcellent_Toolt: Text color for skill numbers shown while holding Shift. This does not change cell backgrounds.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_advanced.autoAssign_Tooltip: Show auto-assign buttons and enable ruleset logic.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_autoAssign.alwaysShowCondit: Condition rows are always editable without an initial click.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_advanced.hideWorkloadBtn_To: Hide the Workload button from the Work tab footer.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_advanced.hideAutoAssignBtn_: Hide the ruleset button from the Work tab footer.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_advanced.debugLogging_Toolt: Output detailed debug messages to the log.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_advanced.restoreDefaults_To: Reset ALL settings to default values.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.rowHoverColor_To: Override color for row highlight on hover.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.columnHoverColor: Override color for column highlight on hover.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.resetRowHoverCol: Reset row hover highlight to the general hover color.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.resetColumnHover: Reset column hover highlight to the general hover color.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.disableBestPawn_: Hide the green marker that identifies the highest-skilled eligible pawn for each Work type.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_highlights.bestPawnBackgrou: Adjust the thickness of the green outline for the best pawn in a work type.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_ux.hideWorktypes_Tooltip: Select work types to hide from the work tab.
LanguageData.BWT_Settings_ui.generalTutorial_Tooltip: Show or resume the tutorial. Turning this off pauses it without clearing progress.
